title: Large values of derivatives of quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions
summary: e study large values of fixed derivatives of quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions on the real segment $1/2\leqσ\leq1$. Assuming GRH, we prove lower bounds in terms of GCD sums and finite Euler products. At the central point, every fixed derivative order is compared with the same square-free GCD sum. In the mesoscopic band $σ=1/2+A/\log_2X$, a renormalized resonator estimates contributions from both halves of the differentiated approximate functional equation.
